svg.title: System architecture: the deployable units and the data they exchange
svg.text: System architecture: the deployable units and the data they exchange
DOCKER DESKTOP VMcompose project late-delivery-prediction · tag = compose profile
oms (the order system, a source) · dwh (the star schema) · airflow, metastore, datahub (metadata of the services)
s3://app-exports (the app's export files, a source) · s3://lakehouse: bronze, silver, gold, _validation (Delta Lake)
developer, once per scale: the two sources
Airflow, daily: DP1 triggers DP2, DP2 triggers DP3
replay of parcel scans: Kafka → Flink windows
An arrow carries the data named on it, from the unit that sends it to the unit that receives it.
B1 and S2 carry no data: they point from the caller to the unit it calls.
The dashed box is a support unit whose arrows are left out: the Airflow webserver, which reads
the airflow database and shows the DAG runs.
